# authwise_provider_github (Data Source)

Builds a ProviderGitHub config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `authorization_params` (Map of String)
- `base_url` (String) GitHub Enterprise Server, e.g. https://ghes.example.com. Empty: github.com. Governs the authorization, token and API hosts together.
- `claim_map` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_map))
- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret_ref` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_secret_ref))
- `identifier_claim` (String) Default: id, which is numeric and permanent; login can change.
- `scopes` (List of String) Default: read:user user:email.

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.

<a id="nestedatt--claim_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claim_map`

Optional:

- `map` (Map of String) target name → source path.
- `passthrough` (List of String) Source names copied through unchanged when present. Applied after `map` and `static`, and never overwrites either.
- `static` (Map of String) target name → literal value, for claims that do not come from anywhere.


<a id="nestedatt--client_secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `client_secret_ref`

Optional:

- `name` (String) tenants/{tenant}/secrets/{secret}. The tenant must be the tenant of the object holding the reference; the writer must hold identity.secrets.use.
